the optimal returns policy is sensitive to the e-marketplace’s price, the demand uncertainty and the returns rate.

(a) the optimal returns policy is not necessarily to accept all returns; (b) the optimal policy is more sensitive to the e-marketplace price when the demand distribution is more skewed; and (c) the optimal policy tends to accept more returns when the e-marketplace is more efficient.
